chart.programText:
A = data('*.indices*.search.query-total', filter=filter('plugin', 'elasticsearch') and (not filter('node_id', '*', match_missing=True)) and (not filter('aggregation', ' * OR aggregation: total', match_missing=True)), rollup='max').max(by=['index']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
